name: trellis
description: Local kanban boards and vaults for AI agents. SessionStart hook injects board state and a command cheatsheet. The skills cover claiming work, recording progress, and when to write an entry.

plugins.name: trellis
plugins.description: Work with trellis board state, cards, and vault entries. SessionStart hook for adoption.

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Spec-first work that stands on tests: one spec per story, cases approved before code, and hooks that check claims against git and the test suite. Uses Trellis when installed; works without it.
